Container.Name: plant-journal
Container.Overview: Private household plant journal. Log in to GHCR and set watch-only labels in the saved Unraid template before installation.

Config.Name: Journal data
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite journal; include this directory in periodic Unraid appdata backups.

Config.Name: Photos
Config.Description: Uploaded plant photos; on the array, not the appdata backup. Directory must be writable by UID/GID 1000:1000.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: LAN and tailnet access; do not forward this port on the public router.
